description: Four-input mixer whose levels are set by a point on an X-Y plane, with each input also on its own output

params.text: Sets the level of that input before the X-Y position scales it, 0 to 1, fully open by default
Sets the X coordinate of the mix point, 0 to 1; A and C fade out as it rises while B and D fade in
Sets the Y coordinate of the mix point, 0 to 1; A and B fade out as it rises while C and D fade in
Attenuverts the X jack's control of the X position, -1 to +1, fully positive by default
Attenuverts the Y jack's control of the Y position, -1 to +1, fully positive by default
Sends 5V to every input jack left unpatched, so the mixer puts out the X-Y weightings themselves as CV; a cable in All In overrides it

inputs.text: One of the four signals being mixed; unpatched it carries whatever the All In jack has
Modulates the X position through its attenuverter
Modulates the Y position through its attenuverter
Feeds this signal to every input jack left unpatched

outputs.text: Carries the four inputs summed after their gain trimpots and their X-Y weightings
That one input on its own, after its gain trimpot and its X-Y weighting
